rev.t: Nice shopping store for all varieties. Usually not crowded. Parking available for 2 wheelers. Friendly staff and neat and clean shop.

EasyMart is our regular grocery shopping supermarket. We generally find all sorts of packed foods, fresh vegetables, snacks, grocery, daily needs, stationery etc. The collection is vast. There are about 4 counters and it moves quickly so …

I had a really disappointing experience at this hypermarket. The prices are much higher compared to other stores, which doesn’t feel justified at all. On top of that, the items are not properly organized, making it difficult to find things …
